name: on-call-card
title: On-call card
description: Who is on call now and next: shift end times in your time zone, a handover flagged in words, an escalation contact and a Page button that asks for a reason.
docs: Page asks for a reason first and waits for `onPage` to settle; reject the promise to show the failure and keep the reason. With no `current` shift the card says Nobody is on call and offers to page the escalation contact. Pass `now` for a stable first render.
